sessions.intent: Implement and verify a small typed feature with meaningful regression tests
sessions.task: Advance Kairn's pending release-readiness work without retuning its frozen retriever or ranker. Read docs/handoffs/2026-10-06-research-continuation.md and the existing pilot reporting types. Add src/bench/pilotClusterDiagnostics.ts exporting summarizeTaskClusters(evidence, options). evidence contains pairRows with taskId, blockId and signedTotalTokenDelta (Kairn minus vanilla); extra public fields may be ignored. options contains seed and samples (default 5000). Return schemaVersion='codex-pilot-task-clusters.v1', pairCount, taskCount, aggregateSignedTotalTokenDelta, medianSignedTotalTokenDelta, clusteredMedianCi95 (null for fewer than two tasks; otherwise {lower,upper,samples,method:'task_cluster_bootstrap'}), and a tasks array of {taskId,pairCount,totalTokenDelta,meanTokenDelta}, sorted by descending regression contribution then taskId. Resample whole tasks with replacement, retain all their paired observations, and compute the pooled median in each draw. Use a deterministic seeded generator and canonical task/block ordering so row order cannot change the result. Reject duplicate block IDs, empty task/block IDs, non-finite deltas, and nonpositive/noninteger sample counts. Empty input has zero totals and a null median/interval. Add useful tests, including correlated repeats. This is a new offline diagnostic, not a new efficacy study, causal training labels or promotion decision. Keep original pilot outputs and report schemas unchanged. Verify the behavior and leave a short local handoff for a fresh session. Do not run a campaign, download models, change dependencies, CI or release flags. The website public pilot artifact at /work/reference/completed-pilot-evidence.json is the completed 45-pair/15-task research input (its identity matches the handoff); it may be read as real input; do not edit it.
